As per prosecution case, there is allegation that as per direction of Government, the informant,
who is PACS Mangager, made agreement on 10.06.2015 with the petitioners and paddy weighing 1662 quintal worth Rs. 27,58,920/- was given to the accused persons for preparation and supply of rice.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.12499 of 2024(3) dt.16-04-2024 Md. Rakib Alam preapred a power of attorney in the name of Md Rakki Ahmad @ Md. Rafi Ahmad with common intention after making conspiracy.
